title: Portfolio Website
description: A high-performance full-stack personal portfolio platform built with React 18, Vite, and Python Flask. Features dynamic multi-repository metadata ingestion, zero-dependency interactive SVG Radar Graph skill visualization, AWS serverless contact outreach pipeline, and containerized deployment with Nginx and Cloudflare edge caching.
Highlights: Dynamic GitHub repo ingestion engine parsing remote PortfolioWebsiteInfo.json metadata with multi-tier caching for instantaneous 0ms repeat page loads
Serverless contact outreach pipeline powered by AWS API Gateway and Lambda, eliminating server-side SMTP overhead
Self-hosted containerized architecture on Ubuntu Server with Docker, Nginx reverse proxy, Gzip compression, and Cloudflare edge caching
Interactive 5-discipline SVG Radar Graph dynamically mapping technical competencies across Frontend, Backend, AI, DevSecOps, and Test Automation
Hardened security and performance architecture featuring Flask rate limiting, authenticated cache purging, strict HTTP headers, and Cloudinary media optimization
